The Pieces From Which the Terms Are Built

Source: R/jfp_outer.R
jfp_eta_dir.Rd

jfp_eta_dir() returns the movement of each equation's predictor along a direction; jfp_dI() a derivative of the family's expected information, contracted along directions; jfp_white(), jfp_rows_B() and jfp_pair_weights() the three shapes in which a derivative of the block's matrix enters (see the comment at the top of R/jfp_outer.R).

Usage

jfp_eta_dir(st, v)

jfp_dI(st, q, r, fixed, dirs)

jfp_white(st, bs, dirs)

jfp_rows_B(st, bs, dirs)

jfp_pair_weights(st, bs, Y, dirs)

Arguments

st

A state, from jfp_state().

v

A direction over the joint vector.

q, r

The pair of the information.

fixed

The equations of the derivatives that are not contracted.

dirs

A list of directions, each as jfp_eta_dir() returns it.

bs

A block's entry of the state.

Y

A symmetric \(\tilde p\times\tilde p\) matrix.

Value

jfp_eta_dir() a list of numeric vectors, one per distribution parameter; jfp_dI() a numeric vector over the observations; jfp_white() a \(\tilde p\times\tilde p\) matrix; jfp_rows_B() a matrix over the joint vector and the \(\tilde p^2\) entries; jfp_pair_weights() a list keyed as statmod_information_at() reads its H.
